title: Social post (Facebook-style)
description: A post in a Facebook-style feed, either in a public community group (public_group variant) or on a personal profile (profile variant). Write it like a real resident would: run-on sentences, capitals for emphasis, a call to share.

groupName.description: Group the post appears in (public_group variant)

groupPrivacy.description: Group privacy shown by the audience icon

authorName.description: Poster's name as shown (often first name + last initial)

authorBadge.description: Optional group badge next to the poster's name

avatarBrief.description: Image-generation brief for the poster's profile photo (media stage, not rendered)
examples: woman in her forties, casual backyard profile photo

timestampRel.description: Relative post age as Facebook shows it

text.description: Post text. Newlines are kept; #hashtags are highlighted.
examples: My sister works at the airport and she just texted me. She said ISIS has taken over the control tower. They are crashing planes into the terminal! GET OUT NOW! Share this!!!

attachedImageBrief.description: Image-generation brief for an attached photo (attached_image slot; media stage only). Leave empty for a text-only post.
examples: blurry phone photo of a crowded check-in hall

reactionTypes.description: Up to three reaction icons shown, most common first

reactionLead.description: Optional 'name and N others' text that replaces the bare count

comments.description: Comments shown under the post (most relevant first). Keep to 0–3.

examples: Is this real?? My husband flies out of there at 2
